```json
{
  "winner": "A",
  "reasons": [
    "Idea A's per-workspace price anchors are sourced to two live competitors: display.dev at €15–€49/mo and Volly at $75/mo with unlimited seats. That is a higher revenue-per-customer band than Idea B's parent-paid $12–15/mo, so a single first sale is more meaningful.",
    "Idea A's acquisition channels are sourced and cost little or nothing. Product Hunt is estimated at ~$3–5 CPA with 3k–15k visitors per featured launch, Show HN costs $0, and marketplace listings are free to $29. They reach dev-adjacent builders directly, which suits a solo operator chasing one paying customer in 90 days.",
    "Idea A can launch as an intentionally thin product (upload, OTP/SSO, directory) with no mandatory pre-launch legal gate. Idea B must design and implement COPPA verifiable parental consent before collecting any child data. Its state-level privacy obligations are flagged but unsourced, which adds legal time and risk inside the window.",
    "Idea B faces a hard price ceiling from Khan Academy Kids, which the brief says is fully free. Its only sourced paid channel is mobile UA at $2.50–$5.00 CPI in North America, which the brief itself says is hard to justify at a sub-$15/mo price.",
    "Idea B's demand quotes come from real parents, but the strongest one is a parent declining to pay. It shows price sensitivity, not willingness to pay a new entrant."
  ],
  "weakest_evidence_in_loser": "Idea B's plan to avoid paid UA depends on organic parenting communities (r/daddit, r/homeschool, r/Parenting), but the brief marks this channel's cost as [unsourced] and calls reach and conversion 'unproven,' so it counts as missing. The $25–$120/hour tutoring-cost figure in the Case For gives no URL ('per multiple tutoring-cost sources'), so it is also effectively unsourced.",
  "confidence_note": "Moderate-to-low confidence. Idea A has real weaknesses of its own. Its demand evidence is one vendor-curated testimonial plus one Reddit post that does not show willingness to pay. The space has at least five near-identical entrants with no clear wedge. Sandboxed execution of agent code is a genuine security liability, shown by Perch's disclosed sandbox escape. Idea A wins mainly because its pricing, channels, and launch path are better sourced and face fewer pre-launch barriers, not because its demand is proven."
}
```
